# One throwaway lab session of seerdb's client against the 26ai encryption bed
# (AES-256 encryption id 17, SHA-2 integrity id 5),
# recorded 2026-09-30 for #1345: a query, then twice an error (in-band break/reset) and a query.
# Each packet line is one server payload || MAC as the client verified it; reset=1 marks
# the first packet after a break/reset exchange, where both sides re-derive.
enc=17
integrity=5

server_iv=666f6f206261722062617a206261742071757578
packet reset=0 
packet reset=0 
packet reset=0
